metadata.title: Top Website UI Designs Worth Learning and Imitating
metadata.description: Benchmark directory of 80 top-tier website UI designs across 8 categories with design styles, highlights, UI patterns, key components, and recommended tech stacks.

categories.name: SaaS & Productivity
categories.description: Tools that excel at dense information design, keyboard-first navigation, fluid state transitions, and distraction-free workflows.

websites.name: Linear
websites.highlights: Defined the modern tech aesthetic; instant keyboard-first workflows; subtle border gradients; ultra-fluid transitions.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Command palette (Cmd+K); subtle border glowing; high-density issue lists; instant optimistic UI updates.
websites.recommended_stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion

websites.name: Raycast
websites.highlights: Interactive homepage with live keyboard simulations; crisp custom icon system; spotlight search focus.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Spotlight launcher UI; interactive manual simulation; extension store grid; hotkey visual badges.

websites.name: Notion
websites.highlights: Pioneer of modular block-based document editing; calm whitespace; collapsible sidebars; playful illustrations.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Slash command (/) inline menus; drag-and-drop block handles; nested page hierarchy; clean sidebar nav.
websites.recommended_stack: React, Custom Canvas/DOM Editor, CSS Modules

websites.name: Figma
websites.highlights: Desktop-grade web application standard; seamless multiplayer cursor presence; modular floating tool panels.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Floating canvas toolbar; collaborative cursor presence with name tags; layered side inspectors; zoom pan canvas.

websites.name: Cron (Notion Calendar)
websites.highlights: Redefined digital calendar UX with keyboard shortcuts, time-zone scrubbing, and distraction-free scheduling.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Time grid drag-to-create; time-zone scrub overlay; quick meeting link generation; seamless theme switching.

websites.name: Arc (The Browser Company)
websites.highlights: Revolutionized browser UX with vertical workspace tabs, custom split views, and playful micro-animations.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Vertical tab bar navigation; collapsible command launcher; space switcher pills; playful onboarding flow.

websites.name: Loom
websites.highlights: Interactive video player controls, instant AI-generated video summaries, and emoji timeline reactions.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Interactive video playback timeline; floating webcam bubble; inline video transcription scrub; quick sharing drawer.

websites.name: Craft Docs
websites.highlights: Blends native macOS/iOS elegance with web agility; deep visual document nesting; card styling.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Card-based document nesting; cover image picker; floating inspector palettes; fluid drag-and-drop reorganization.

websites.name: Superhuman
websites.highlights: Zero-inbox philosophy; lightning-fast execution (<100ms response); distraction-free typography.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Keyboard-first navigation (no mouse required); split-inbox tabs; hotkey cheat sheets; minimal email reading pane.

websites.name: Height
websites.highlights: Spreadsheet flexibility combined with project tracking; inline cell editing; integrated task chat.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Inline spreadsheet cell editor; real-time filter pills; contextual chat drawer; multi-attribute grouping.

categories.name: Developer Tools & Infrastructure
categories.description: Platforms focused on developer ergonomics, terminal aesthetics, code playgrounds, bento grids, and technical documentation.

websites.name: Vercel
websites.design_style: Geist Design System / Monochrome Bento Grid
websites.highlights: Sets the global standard for developer marketing and dashboards; razor-sharp Geist typography; terminal demos.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Bento grid cards with hover glows; interactive CLI/deploy previews; tabbed dashboard metrics; subtle grid lines.

websites.name: Supabase
websites.highlights: Emerald neon accents on deep dark backgrounds; interactive multi-language code switchers; SQL console.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Multi-language code tabs (JS, Python, Dart, SQL); database table explorer; animated architecture flow diagrams.

websites.name: Resend
websites.highlights: Distraction-free email API platform; live React email preview pane; instant API key copy; clean analytics.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Split code editor + live email preview; frictionless API key generation; clean quota usage progress bars.

websites.name: Clerk
websites.highlights: Modern auth component showcase; interactive component customizer on the homepage; multi-tenant switcher.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Interactive component previewer; embeddable auth cards; step-by-step onboarding wizard; organization switcher.

websites.name: GitHub
websites.design_style: Primer Design System / Dense Engineering Hub
websites.highlights: The definitive repository hub; dense information architecture; clean split/unified code diffs; activity heatmaps.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Side-by-side / unified code diffs; yearly activity commit heatmaps; multi-tab settings panes; markdown preview tabs.
websites.recommended_stack: Ruby on Rails, Primer Design System, React

websites.name: Tailwind CSS
websites.highlights: The benchmark for developer documentation; live side-by-side utility code and component preview; quick search.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Instant modal search (Cmd+K); side-by-side code/preview toggle; responsive viewport simulator; copy snippet badges.

websites.name: Railway
websites.highlights: Visual infrastructure canvas; servers and databases represented as connected interactive nodes.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Node-based architecture canvas; animated connecting cables; live deployment logs terminal; template store cards.

websites.name: PlanetScale
websites.highlights: Brings Git concepts to relational databases; visual schema branching; deep query telemetry charts.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Visual database branch graph; schema diff review modal; interactive query performance charts; deploy request pills.

websites.name: Mintlify
websites.highlights: Standard for modern documentation; lightning-fast navigation; built-in interactive OpenAPI request runner.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Sticky 3-column layout (Nav - Guide - Interactive API Runner); response status code preview; instant copy snippets.

websites.name: Postman
websites.highlights: Complex desktop-grade API client on the web; multi-tab request builder; collapsible JSON response viewer.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Tabbed request workspace; collapsible JSON tree inspector; environment variable dropdowns; mock server builder.

categories.name: E-Commerce & Direct-to-Consumer (D2C)
categories.description: High-conversion, sensory digital retail experiences with interactive customizers, 3D showcases, and refined product storytelling.

websites.name: Apple Store
websites.design_style: High-Touch Product Configurator / Clean Swiss Luxe
websites.highlights: The gold standard of digital retail; seamless hardware customizer; modular feature carousels; sticky checkout.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Interactive device spec customizer (finish, capacity, trade-in); sticky purchase drawer; high-res pinch zoom.
websites.recommended_stack: Custom Apple Web Engine, Vanilla JS/Modern DOM

websites.name: Aesop
websites.design_style: Warm Earthy Tones / Brutalist Editorial Elegance
websites.highlights: Poetic sensory commerce; delicate grid lines; generous whitespace; contextual ingredient accordions.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Editorial product storytelling; slide-out cart drawer with free sample selector; aroma profile badges.

websites.name: Bang & Olufsen
websites.highlights: High-fidelity luxury audio showcase; acoustic visualization; interactive 3D material and finish selector.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Material & colorway switcher; full-bleed immersive hero video sliders; acoustic feature breakdown modules.

websites.name: Teenage Engineering
websites.highlights: Dieter Rams-inspired industrial aesthetics; blueprint schematics; interactive browser-playable synths.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Schematic line-art product displays; interactive digital knobs/keys; raw monospace spec tables; minimal grid.
websites.recommended_stack: Vue.js / Nuxt, Web Audio API, Canvas

websites.name: Rimowa
websites.highlights: High-end luggage experience; interactive monogramming customizer; wheel and handle color customizer.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Monogram customizer with real-time embossed initials; smooth filter drawer; wheel & handle color preview.

websites.name: Bellroy
websites.highlights: Famous 'Slim Your Wallet' interactive slider comparing bulky vs Bellroy wallets with card count controls.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Interactive thickness comparison slider; pocket-fit visualization; feature hotspot popovers on product images.

websites.name: Allbirds
websites.highlights: Clean modern footwear commerce; carbon footprint badges; instant size and color stock availability indicators.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Carbon footprint label on every product; instant color swatch toggle with stock preview; quick-add drawer.

websites.name: Glossier
websites.highlights: Accessible beauty commerce; interactive foundation shade finder; customer lookbook integrated with product.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Shade finder tool with diverse model photography; sticky Add to Bag bar; customer review photo gallery filter.

websites.name: hardgraft
websites.design_style: Raw Artisanal Luxury / High-Resolution Masonry Grid
websites.highlights: Distraction-free artisanal leather goods; full-bleed masonry image grid; subtle price reveal on hover.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Image-dominant masonry catalog; minimal hover price and title reveal; distraction-free product detail page.

websites.name: Nike
websites.design_style: High-Energy Athletic / Nike By You 3D Customizer
websites.highlights: Bold athletic typography; multi-attribute faceted filtering; interactive 3D shoe customization engine.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Nike By You 3D sneaker colorway customizer; multi-tiered sticky filter drawer; endless scroll grid.

categories.name: Modern Fintech & Banking
categories.description: Financial platforms that turn complex numbers, transactions, and compliance into trustworthy, friction-free interfaces.

websites.name: Stripe
websites.design_style: Flowing Mesh Gradients / Precision Financial UI
websites.highlights: The definitive benchmark for internet commerce; animated mesh gradients; live code payment demos.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Interactive animated gradient canvas; payment method tabs (Cards, Apple Pay, Klarna); interactive pricing slider.

websites.name: Mercury
websites.design_style: Deep Jewel Tones / Modern Corporate Banking
websites.highlights: Calm banking UX for startups; multi-entity account switchers; clean wire transfer modal wizard.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Financial telemetry sparklines; multi-company switcher; one-click card freeze toggle; wire transfer step wizard.

websites.name: Wise
websites.highlights: Pioneer of radical fee transparency; famous live foreign exchange calculator with comparison against banks.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Real-time currency exchange calculator with delivery time estimates; multi-currency balance cards.

websites.name: Cash App
websites.highlights: Breaks all traditional financial tropes; surreal 3D floating assets; mobile-first desktop interface.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Surreal 3D interactive floating coins/cards; minimal single-input cashtag flow; oversized typography.

websites.name: Revolut
websites.design_style: Dark Sleek Fintech / Glowing Neon Multi-Currency
websites.highlights: Multi-feature financial super-app; dynamic debit card visualizer; lifestyle perks mega-menu.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Custom debit card 3D visualizer; mega-menu feature directory; stock/crypto trading preview cards.

websites.name: Robinhood
websites.design_style: Zero-Friction Retail Investing / Market Color Shifter
websites.highlights: Democratized retail trading; dynamic UI color shifting based on market status (green/red); simple order form.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Portfolio green/red color mode shifting; simplified candlestick stock charts; instant order review slider.

websites.name: Ramp
websites.highlights: High-growth corporate spend platform; interactive ROI savings calculator; live card policy rules.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Interactive savings calculator; automated expense approval hierarchy tree; live card spending limit sliders.

websites.name: Brex
websites.highlights: Global enterprise card and travel platform; multi-currency spend dashboard; interactive budget manager.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Budget allocation hierarchy tree; travel itinerary booking interface; automated receipt policy builder.

websites.name: Monzo
websites.highlights: Famous hot-coral branding; visual savings goals; collaborative bill splitting and instant notifications.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Visual 'Savings Pots' with target progress rings; split-the-bill friend selector; instant spending breakdown pie.

websites.name: Klarna
websites.highlights: Shopping-first fintech; transparent 'Pay in 4' installment schedule visualizer; curated wishlist boards.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Visual payment schedule timeline (Today, 2, 4, 6 weeks); price-drop alert notifications; wishlist collections.

categories.name: Creative Studios & Interactive Experiences
categories.description: Boundary-pushing agencies that showcase WebGL, physics-driven interactions, kinetic typography, and bespoke motion design.

websites.name: Active Theory
websites.highlights: Pushes browser rendering limits; custom WebGL engine; interactive 3D particle systems; spatial audio.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: WebGL particle canvas backgrounds; custom cursor magnetic distortion; spatial audio toggles; 3D navigation.
websites.recommended_stack: Custom WebGL (Hydra Engine), Three.js, Web Audio API

websites.name: Locomotive
websites.design_style: Smooth Inertia Scroll / Kinetic Editorial Typography
websites.highlights: Creators of Locomotive Scroll; unmatched scroll physics; text masking on scroll; horizontal transitions.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Smooth inertia scrolling physics; scroll-triggered text reveals; image parallax scaling; horizontal galleries.

websites.name: Pentagram
websites.highlights: World-class typographic authority; pure black-and-white grid; massive multi-decade design archive.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Strict typographic baseline grid; multi-tag portfolio filter drawer; responsive case study layout.

websites.name: Basement Studio
websites.design_style: High-Octane Dark Mode / Lenis Smooth Scroll / Retro Glitch
websites.highlights: Creators of Lenis; retro-futuristic glitch micro-animations; spatial audio feedback; custom typography.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Lenis smooth scroll physics; sound effect hover feedback; magnetic buttons; dynamic viewport scaling.

websites.name: BASIC/DEPT
websites.design_style: Bold Modern Agency / Full-Bleed Video Reels
websites.highlights: High-impact agency branding; seamless page routing without white flashes; interactive B-side archive.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Shared element page transitions; full-bleed video heroes; sound-responsive cursor hover states.

websites.name: Cuberto
websites.design_style: Liquid Organic Motion / Gooey Morphing Cursor
websites.highlights: Pioneers of morphing cursor interactions; liquid SVG gooey filters; smooth mobile-like gestures.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Custom cursor that morphs into play buttons/drag badges; elastic hover pull; liquid page transitions.

websites.name: Resn
websites.highlights: Legendary interactive design agency; gamified 3D navigation; interactive easter eggs; surreal soundscapes.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Gamified 3D navigation globe; mouse gesture manipulation of 3D objects; bespoke interactive easter eggs.

websites.name: ToyFight
websites.highlights: Humorous 3D action figurines; physics-based collisions; bold two-tone color blocking.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: 3D figurines that collide and tumble on scroll; humorous micro-copy; bold contrasting color split sections.

websites.name: MediaMonks
websites.design_style: Global Mega-Agency / Dynamic Case Study Drawers
websites.highlights: Handles vast multi-disciplinary global work; dynamic case study preview drawers; interactive office map.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Dynamic case study preview drawer; interactive global office map; adaptive filter pills across disciplines.

websites.name: Fantasy (FI)
websites.design_style: Futuristic UI Concepts / Cinematic Case Studies
websites.highlights: Pioneering future operating systems, automotive dashboards, and AI agents with cinematic design walk-throughs.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Video-rich UI concept walkthroughs; sticky feature breakdown sidebars; prototype interaction recordings.

categories.name: AI-Native Applications
categories.description: Frontiers of interaction design for AI, featuring streaming responses, dual-pane artifact views, generative canvases, and prompt affordances.

websites.name: Perplexity AI
websites.highlights: Pioneer of conversational search UX; real-time source citation pills; dynamic follow-up query suggestions.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Inline numbered citation pills with instant source previews; answer streaming cards; related query suggestions.

websites.name: Claude by Anthropic
websites.highlights: Pioneered Artifacts UI; warm terracotta and ivory palette; side-by-side interactive code/UI sandbox.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Dual-pane chat + artifact split screen; live interactive HTML/SVG sandbox; calm editorial typography.
websites.recommended_stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Custom Markdown Parser

websites.name: v0 by Vercel
websites.highlights: AI generative UI platform; live React/Tailwind component rendering; version iteration branching.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Component version branch selector; live code/preview toggle (desktop/mobile); inspect element to iterate.

websites.name: Cursor
websites.design_style: Developer-First Dark UI / Inline AI Diff Reviewer
websites.highlights: Redefining software engineering; inline ghost text suggestions; multi-file agentic Composer modal.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Inline code diff acceptance UI (accept/reject changes); floating prompt composer; file context tagger (@file).
websites.recommended_stack: Electron, VS Code Core, Custom AI Engine

websites.name: Midjourney
websites.highlights: Infinite visual canvas for generated art; prompt parameter metadata cards; one-click remix/upscale tools.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Infinite masonry image grid; prompt parameter tags inspector; instant lightbox with upscale/variation tools.

websites.name: Runway
websites.highlights: Professional video generation studio; motion brush overlay; multi-track timeline layer controls.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Motion brush canvas overlay; multi-asset media bin; video generation queue with progress indicators.
websites.recommended_stack: React, WebGL, Canvas API, Web Workers

websites.name: ElevenLabs
websites.design_style: Sound Wave Telemetry / Sleek Voice Library Cards
websites.highlights: Interactive voice synthesis playground; real-time waveform audio scrubbers; voice cloning recorder.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Waveform audio scrubber; voice timbre/accent filter tags; live TTS slider controls (stability, clarity).
websites.recommended_stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Web Audio API

websites.name: Granola
websites.design_style: Serene AI Notepad / Split Human-AI Meeting Notes
websites.highlights: Blends human note-taking with AI enhancements; minimal distraction-free typography; ambient status.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Split human-typed notes and AI-enhanced summaries; ambient audio recording status indicator; minimal toolbar.

websites.name: Krea AI
websites.highlights: Pioneered instant real-time AI canvas; draw on left, photoreal rendering on right at 60fps.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Real-time split-screen canvas; floating tactile tool palette; dynamic AI weight slider; quick prompt booster.

websites.name: Suno
websites.design_style: Musical Social Feed / Synced Karaoke Lyrics
websites.highlights: Generative music platform; persistent audio player bar; real-time synced lyrics; track remix tree.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Persistent audio player footer bar; synced karaoke-style lyrics scroller; track variation and remix tree.
websites.recommended_stack: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Web Audio API

categories.name: Editorial, Media & Digital Storytelling
categories.description: Exemplary visual journalism, scrollytelling, high-contrast typography, and rich reading environments.

websites.name: The Pudding
websites.highlights: The undisputed pioneer of visual essays; scroll-driven step-by-step chart transitions; explorable data.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Scroll-driven step-by-step chart transitions; sticky data graphic with narrative text; audio clip integration.
websites.recommended_stack: D3.js, Svelte, Scrollama, Web Audio API

websites.name: The New York Times (Visuals)
websites.highlights: Gold standard for visual investigations and data journalism; 3D terrain maps; interactive timelines.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Reading progress indicators; multi-column editorial grid; interactive explainer graphics; footnotes popovers.
websites.recommended_stack: Custom NYT Framework, D3.js, Three.js, React

websites.name: The Verge
websites.highlights: Neon duotones; Storystream format bringing real-time social micro-updates into editorial coverage.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Storystream live-feed component; bold contrasting neon color blocks; article reading time and share docks.

websites.name: Pitchfork
websites.design_style: Iconic Album Review Card / Score Badge Layout
websites.highlights: The definitive music review format; decimal score badge; rich album artwork; tracklist breakdowns.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Decimal rating badge widget (e.g. 8.4); album tracklist accordions; sticky article audio snippet player.

websites.name: Wired
websites.design_style: Tech-Forward Magazine Grid / Gear Review Cards
websites.highlights: Modern technical magazine layout; high-contrast borders; gear review breakdown cards (Pros/Cons/Specs).
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Product review 'The Good / The Bad' cards; pull-quote typography; author byline cards with social links.

websites.name: Bloomberg Graphics
websites.highlights: World-class economic data visualizations; interactive calculators; scrollytelling with locked axes.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Interactive economic sliders; scrollytelling sticky chart viewport; financial data legend tooltips.

websites.name: It's Nice That
websites.design_style: Playful Creative Culture / Dynamic Masonry Tags
websites.highlights: Celebrates visual creativity; expansive, vibrant grid; color-coded tag pills; clean image framing.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Dynamic color-coded category tags; masonry image layout; creative credit badges on artwork.

websites.name: Rest of World
websites.highlights: Exceptional reading typography supporting global languages; bespoke visual maps; clean reading mode.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Multi-lingual typographic pairing; subtle reading mode controls; bespoke geographic map embeds.

websites.name: Kinfolk
websites.highlights: Masterclass in breathing room and understated luxury; delicate serif typography; slow editorial layout.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Generous whitespace ratio; elegant serif font pairings; understated sticky navigation; full-bleed photo spreads.

websites.name: Smashing Magazine
websites.design_style: Exemplary Web Accessibility / Floating Table of Contents
websites.highlights: Web design publication benchmark for accessibility (a11y); clear floating table of contents; rich code styling.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Floating table of contents with active section highlighting; accessible reading controls; author bio cards.

categories.name: Community, Educational & Lifestyle
categories.description: Engaging community networks, gamified educational products, and habit-forming lifestyle platforms.

websites.name: Duolingo
websites.highlights: World-class gamification UI; 3D isometric path; streak counters; celebratory micro-animations.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Learning journey path (nodes, crowns, chests); streak flame counter; celebratory quiz completion modals.

websites.name: Airbnb
websites.design_style: Marketplace Gold Standard / Floating Expandable Search
websites.highlights: Sticky expandable search pill bar; category iconography slider; synchronized map and list split view.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Expandable multi-step search bar (Where, When, Who); photo collage grid; split map/list view with synced hover.

websites.name: Readcv
websites.highlights: Distraction-free personal profile; project attachment previews; clean career timeline; zero-spam aesthetic.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Clean career timeline UI; expandable media attachments; minimalist profile header; clean skill tag pills.

websites.name: Discord
websites.highlights: Definitive community chat layout; 3-column navigation; voice channel status bar; contextual action popovers.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: 3-tier sidebar hierarchy (Servers -> Channels -> Chat); voice room HUD; contextual message action popovers.

websites.name: Headspace
websites.design_style: Calming Organic Shapes / Soothing Soundscape UI
websites.highlights: Designed for stress relief; soothing pastel color palettes; friendly character illustrations; progress rings.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Soothing color psychology; mood check-in slider; audio meditation player with ambient background timer.

websites.name: MasterClass
websites.design_style: Cinematic Streaming Learning / Dark Luxury Theme
websites.highlights: Streaming entertainment UI applied to education; trailer video hover previews; structured lesson drawer.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Cinematic video hero banners; syllabus progress checklist; hover video preview cards.

websites.name: Dribbble
websites.design_style: Visual Inspiration Feed / Dynamic Color Palette Swatch
websites.highlights: Creative community shot gallery; dynamic tag filters; interactive shot lightbox with color palette extractor.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Media shot card with author attribution; color swatch extractor on images; quick save to collection modal.

websites.name: Spotify Web
websites.design_style: Persistent Playback Engine / Ambient Color Glow
websites.highlights: Persistent audio player bar; ambient color extractor matching album art; collapsible queue/lyrics side panel.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Sticky player bottom bar; album art ambient glow; collapsible right-side drawer (lyrics/queue/artist info).
websites.recommended_stack: React, Web Playback SDK, Custom CSS

websites.name: Refind
websites.design_style: Curated Knowledge Digest / Summary Takeaways Cards
websites.highlights: Daily 5-link digest; key takeaways bullet points under links; clean reading backlog management.
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Summary takeaways card format; reading time estimation pills; simple thumbs-up/save action buttons.

websites.name: Behance
websites.design_style: Heavy Creative Case Study / Floating Appreciation Bar
websites.highlights: Long-form creative case study viewer; floating appreciation/like widget; creative tool badges (Photoshop, etc).
websites.patterns_to_imitate: Floating sticky appreciation bar; project credit breakdown; creative tool badge tags.
